Internal helper: is an expression shaped as data?

Source: R/checks.R
dot-jst_expr_data_shaped.Rd

For the data-first resolver (Session 392): an expression in the data's place that stopped is read as data – a data frame's name typed wrong in it said, .jst_expr_data_stop() – only when it has the shape of one: the object of [, [[, $ or @, or a call of a function that takes a data frame and gives one back (subset(), head(), na.omit(), merge() and kin), parentheses read through. A condition or a computed vector – Agee > 40, log(Income) – is not, and keeps the resolver's stops, which name the default frame where one is set.

Usage

.jst_expr_data_shaped(e)

Arguments

e

The expression.

Value

TRUE or FALSE.
